auth login.--clipboard: Copies an OAuth device code into the desktop clipboard; there is no clipboard or human device authorization in the harness.
auth login.--web: Successful use opens a browser and requires human OAuth approval. Only its incompatibility with --with-token is tested; PAT login is exercised live instead.
auth login.--scopes: Requesting additional scopes requires the browser/device OAuth approval flow, not a supplied PAT. The --with-token incompatibility is tested, but successful interactive scope approval is not automated.

auth refresh.--clipboard: Copies a one-time device code to a desktop clipboard and requires manual OAuth approval; neither is available in this noninteractive harness.
auth refresh.--insecure-storage: Controls persistence of the newly approved OAuth credential; cannot exercise that persistence without completing human device/browser authorization.
auth refresh.--remove-scopes: Scope removal obtains a replacement OAuth credential after human authorization; the harness has PATs and no unattended device approver.
auth refresh.--reset-scopes: Resetting scopes requires replacement OAuth authorization in a browser/device flow; cannot safely finish it noninteractively.
auth refresh.--scopes: Expanding PAT scopes is not possible. A successful refresh requires a human-approved replacement OAuth credential, so only the clean missing-login failure is run.

search code.--web: Opens the search in a browser instead of querying the API. The harness intentionally disables browsers; no-browser REST search and output formatting are exercised.

search commits.--web: Opens a browser search page rather than running API search; desktop browser interaction is outside the noninteractive harness.

search issues.--web: Opens a browser search page rather than running API search; desktop browser interaction is outside the noninteractive harness.

search prs.--web: Opens a browser search page rather than running API search; desktop browser interaction is outside the noninteractive harness.

search repos.--web: Opens a browser search page rather than running API search; desktop browser interaction is outside the noninteractive harness.
